_doc: Registry of the consumers that ship the VGraph WASM engine, kept on one version so a version number identifies an engine build wherever it is quoted. release-plugins.sh reads this file, bumps each entry via its own ./release.sh, and writes the resulting versions back here. setup-plugins.sh clones any missing entry that has a repo URL; entries without one live inside this monorepo and are skipped. Add a new consumer by appending an entry.
